title: KillSwitchState
description: Result of KillSwitchWorkflow.killswitch_state query. Consumed by risk.check_entry (workflow-not-found and other non-Success outcomes → fail closed at the call site with KILL_SWITCH_UNAVAILABLE).

tripped.description: True iff the switch is currently active (trips block new entries; cool-down after reset is reported via cooling_down_until).

reason.description: Trip reason when tripped=true. Empty when never tripped or reset.

tripped_at.description: RFC3339 UTC trip timestamp. Null when never tripped or after a reset.

cooling_down_until.description: After reset, new entries are blocked with KILL_SWITCH_COOLING_DOWN until this timestamp. Null when not in cool-down.

trading_day.description: Current trading day the auto-trip heartbeat is evaluating (America/New_York).
